turns.user: why are the romanian deadlifts after the squats and not before
turns.reply:
Barbell Back Squats are your Tier 1 primary compound lift for today. They demand the absolute most from your central nervous system, quads, and core, so we program them first while you are completely fresh and have the highest energy. 

Romanian Deadlifts are a Tier 2 compound. While they are still a heavy, demanding movement, they focus more on the posterior chain (hamstrings and glutes) and don't require the same level of total-body stabilization as a heavy squat. Putting squats first ensures you can lift safely with maximum power, whereas squatting heavy after your hamstrings and lower back are already fatigued from RDLs would compromise your squat form and increase your injury risk.

How are your legs feeling today after last Tuesday's squat session?
